name: Recipe Box
shortDescription: Your agent finds the recipes; you keep, skip, or cook them this week.
description: A box of recipes your agent found for you, each a photo card with the dish, its link, the total time, how many it serves, the ingredients, the short steps, and the one line on why the agent picked it. Keep a recipe, skip it, or drag it onto a day of the week on the wooden strip along the bottom. When the week looks right, tap Plan the week: the agent adds up every ingredient for your household, sorts them by aisle, and the shopping list prints up out of the strip like a till receipt, ready to tick off in the store. Every recipe, choice, and list stays on your computer, in your project's own data folder.
setup: Ask, in one message: what you love to cook, anything you never eat, how many people you cook for, and how many dinners a week you want planned. Then pick a look: kitchen (light), cast iron (dark), or auto, which follows your device. No keys are needed and no service is used: the agent finds recipes with its own tools, and every recipe, choice, and list stays in the project's data folder on your computer.
